examples.arabic: ذهبت الى السوق المحلي مساء امس
examples.english: I went to the local market yesterday evening
examples.transliteration: Dhahabtu ila as-sooq al-mahali masaa ams
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

examples.english: Today I went to the local market.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.arabic: اليوم ذهبت الجدة وحفيدتها الى السوق المحلي
examples.english: Today, the grandmother and her granddaughter went to the local market.
examples.transliteration: Al-yawma dhahabat al-jaddatu wa-ḥafīdatuhā ilā as-sūqi al-maḥallī.

examples.arabic: في الصباح ذهبت الى السوق المحلي
examples.english: In the morning, I went to the local market.
examples.transliteration: Fi as-sabah thahabtu ila as-suq al-mahali.
